name: Millennium Hotel and Conference Centre Gloucester London
detail: It is conveniently located almost right in front of Gloucester Street Station. The room was relatively spacious, and the single red sofa added a nice accent. The bathroom had a bathtub, and hot water came out quickly from the faucet, making it comfortable. It's a fairly ordinary hotel, so I feel the rates are higher compared to other countries, but considering that other places in London are even more expensive, I suppose this is about right.

name: Copthorne Tara Hotel London Kensington
detail: The recommended points are its proximity to the station and the spacious rooms. The hotel is old, but they do provide cleaning services (you can choose from three options: no cleaning, towel exchange, or cleaning), so I didn't have any issues. The water pressure in the shower is somewhat weak. Overall, I was satisfied considering the price.

name: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel & Spa London
detail: This hotel is good value for money. Set in a lovely area. Loved the balcony. It’s a little out of the way, but the Thames boat is a great way to get around if you need to get into the city, or you can uber. Breakfast was delicious - a great continental spread and hot options in a buffet.

name: Zedwell Capsule Hotel Piccadilly Circus
detail: I stayed for three nights. The location is right in the middle of Piccadilly Circus, making it perfect as a base. - Size It is about the size of one tatami mat, but it has a mirror, so I didn't feel the narrowness too much. - Security I had a backpack and a daypack, but I kept them in the room while I was sleeping and when I went out. I think it's safer to lock up when going out, so I recommend bringing a padlock. - Toilet/Shower There are many installed for guests, so I don't think there was much chance of running into anyone. There were comments about the shower being hot, and that is true at times, but it was temporary. - Noise Generally, I think it was quiet. Since the shower and toilet are separated by a door, I didn't hear any sounds from them at all. - Service Even during check-in/check-out, if I didn't understand something, the staff was quick to support me. - Ventilation If I had to mention something, this was a slight concern. There were some hot days, so I wished for a bit more air conditioning.

name: Strand Palace
detail: A great location in the West End, just a short walk from Trafalgar Square, the British Museum, and Big Ben. There are buses directly to the Tate Britain Museum right outside, and it's close to various theaters in the West End, with the Six Theater just downstairs. Covent Garden has a variety of nice shops and many great restaurants. The hotel staff are very friendly and assigned me a great room. The room is small but newly decorated and very clean, with a strong showerhead that washes away the fatigue of the day’s travel. Upon check-in, I was given a can of purified water, and I can get a new one at the elevator after finishing it. The bed is very comfortable, and I sleep well every night. Although sometimes the noise from the hallway is a bit loud, wearing earplugs makes it almost inaudible.

name: Otherwander Soho Pod Hotel
detail: I stayed for four nights on a sightseeing trip. The location was excellent and perfect for tourism. The fee for storing large suitcases was high. Overall, the building was new, clean, and nice. I think organizing belongings is easy, so I recommend the lower bunk. It was good to be able to book right before the stay, but due to its prime location, it was a bit more expensive for a capsule hotel. For your reference, I'll provide detailed information. [About the location] There are various subway lines and bus stops nearby, making it a very good location. It is highly recommended for sightseeing in London. There are many supermarkets and restaurants nearby, so you won't have trouble finding meals. [About the room] There is a small shelf and many hooks to hang various items. There is one C-type charging port, two USB ports, and one plug. There is also a towel rack and a mirror. Free towel fabric slippers are available. One bath towel is free, but there is a charge for additional towels. There is no cleaning service for bed linen changes. Bathrobes can be rented for a fee. Large suitcases that you would check in on a plane need to be stored in the staff room for an additional charge. It started at £10 for 12 hours (about 2000-2500 yen). Those who left their bags outside were warned. There is space in the room for luggage small enough to take on a plane. I was on the lower bunk, but the top bunk moves a bit, though it wasn't particularly bothersome. [About the keys] All entrances, gates, and room doors require a QR code, so you need to keep your smartphone with you even when going to the shower room. There is free Wi-Fi, which works normally. It takes a bit of time to scan, but you can try moving it closer or farther away a few times to get it to work. I would appreciate if the scanning accuracy could be improved. [About the bathroom] There were plenty of shower rooms, toilets, sinks, and hairdryers. They are cleaned regularly. Each shower room has three hooks and one chair for placing belongings. There are overhead showers and two handheld showers, making them easy to use. It's possible to use the free slippers, but if you're particular about it, having beach sandals is a good idea. Body soap and shampoo are provided. Using the shampoo here made my hair coarse, so I recommend bringing your own treatment or shampoo. There are also barrier-free shower rooms and toilets. [About the lounge] There are vending machines selling sandwiches and drinks. There is a coffee maker with options like café latte. Drinking water and hot water are free. There are no microwaves or refrigerators. Paper spoons and forks are available for use. There are numerous sofas and desks, but since there are many business people, most of them were using their laptops.

name: Mimi's Hotel Soho
detail: I made a reservation near the theater to watch Les Misérables. It's about a 5-6 minute walk away. The hotel has a bar, so it can get a bit noisy when returning, but it is soundproofed, and the room is very quiet. There are staff members at the entrance, which makes it feel safe. The room was a bit small for placing luggage, but the bed was very spacious and comfortable to sleep on. Both the room and the bathroom were clean. Above all, the staff was kind, which made the trip very enjoyable. I will definitely make a reservation again.

name: Hilton London Paddington
detail: Overall, it was a comfortable hotel. What surprised me was the grandeur of the breakfast buffet in the morning. They had honey served straight from the honeycomb, and it was delicious. The preconceived notion that British food is bad was overturned. The staff was friendly and very accommodating to even small requests, which I found very appealing. The location was good, and I enjoyed crossing paths with locals who were jogging or horseback riding in Hyde Park during my morning walk, heading toward the Kensington area where I could visit the Royal Albert Hall, the V&A Museum, and Harrods on foot. The bed was also fairly spacious for a British hotel, but the only drawback was that the sheets were not changed during the bed-making. However, they might have been willing to change them had I requested it. In conclusion, it’s a hotel I would like to stay at again.

name: Putera Puteri Residence
detail: It was convenient to store my luggage before checking in, and I was worried because I was assigned to the fourth floor without an elevator, but they kindly helped with my luggage. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. There was ample space. The window was behind the bed, making it hard to see outside, but there was an exterior window above the bathroom, so I checked the weather and started my day. The shower booth in the bathroom wasn't very clean, but the rest of the cleaning was done well, so I stayed comfortably for about a week. There was an additional heating device in the wardrobe for when it got cold, so I managed well. On checkout day, they helped with my luggage down to the fourth floor, and after a walk around the area, I checked out feeling satisfied with their kindness. It was conveniently located near Paddington Station, which was great for meals and snacks. I highly recommend it for traveling by subway.

name: The Z Hotel Tottenham Court Road
detail: I made a reservation just to stay for one night on the last day of my trip. From the kind guidance of the staff at the reception, I felt good, and the room was small but clean and had everything I needed, which made me feel even better. In particular, after checkout, they provided free luggage storage, allowing me to explore London a little more before my flight time.
